title: Program Term, Notice and Credit Hold Terms, SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program
content:
# Term, Notice and Credit Hold Terms

Each tier of the SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program carries a minimum program term counted from go-live, a written notice period for ending the program, a fee when the program ends before the minimum term, and a rule for what happens to redemptions while the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold.

| Tier | Minimum program term from go-live (months) | Calendar days of written notice to end the program | Fee when the program ends before the minimum term (USD) | Redemptions while the customer's credit account is on hold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 0 | 30 | 0.00 | Suspend all |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 12 | 30 | 250.00 | Suspend all |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 12 | 30 | 500.00 | Suspend all |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 12 | 60 | 750.00 | Suspend all |
| SafeStep Premier | 24 | 60 | 1500.00 | Honor issued vouchers |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 24 | 90 | 3000.00 | Honor issued vouchers |

## The two credit hold rules

- **Suspend all** — every redemption is suspended while the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold. This rule applies on SafeStep Voucher Basic, SafeStep Voucher Plus, SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear and SafeStep Mobile Fitting.
- **Honor issued vouchers** — vouchers issued before the suspension continue to be honored while the account is on hold. This rule applies on SafeStep Premier and SafeStep Enterprise.

## Notes

- SafeStep Voucher Basic has no minimum term (0 months) and an early termination fee of 0.00.
- The notice period is counted in calendar days.

## Reading the terms

**What notice does a SafeStep Mobile Fitting customer give to end the program?** 60 calendar days of written notice.

**What is the minimum term on SafeStep Premier?** 24 months from go-live; the fee for ending before it is 1500.00.
